verdict.rationale: Bugbot's documented surfaces are PR-based: automatic reviews on PR updates, manual triggers via PR comments, and findings posted as PR comments. The evidence shows no CLI, no review of local diffs, and no machine-readable output. One community user's GitHub Action trigger is a user-side workaround that still posts PR comments, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I run reviews from a CLI against local diffs or in CI scripts, with machine-readable output my tooling can consume
